name: Fall Away
overview: Scripture warns that those who have experienced the truth of the gospel and the work of the Holy Spirit can still fall away through willful sin, as Hebrews teaches that deliberate sin after knowing the truth leaves no further sacrifice for sins. The call to restoration in Galatians emphasizes the need for spiritual humility and gentle correction when a believer stumbles. Salvation is found only in faith in the Lord Jesus Christ, underscoring the necessity of perseverance in genuine belief to avoid falling away.
